unavailable_or_unclassified: Finite samples of independently plausible kernels do not supply consistency on the full visited span. Ideal passive collection/threshold effects exclude undeclared dark counts, dead time, nonlinear readout and reset models. Joint no-click is Gamma(I-sum E_r), not a product of pulled-back no-click effects. No independent converter joint probability follows from separate marginals.
